rules.text: The default return period is 30 days from delivery for all items ordered via phone or online store.
rules.quote: We offer a hassle-free 30-day return period on all items ordered via phone or our online store.

rules.text: Orders placed between November 18 and December 25 have an extended 45-day return period from delivery.
rules.quote: Orders placed between Monday, November 18 and December 25 are eligible for an extended 45-day return period for items ordered through our online store.
rules.reviewNote: The summary adds 'from delivery,' but the quote does not specify that the 45-day period is from delivery; it only states an extended 45-day return period. This is an unsupported detail.

rules.text: Final Sale items are not eligible for return or exchange.
rules.quote: Final Sale items are not eligible for return or exchange

rules.text: In the US, customers can pay a $3.50 prepaid return fee at checkout to cover return costs.
rules.quote: Pay a $3.50 prepaid return fee at checkout, which covers the cost of a return made in accordance with this policy

rules.text: If the prepaid return option is declined in the US, a $10 restocking fee is deducted from the refund.
rules.quote: Decline the prepaid return option, in which case a $10 restocking fee will be deducted from any refund if the item is returned

rules.text: In Canada, a $20 restocking fee is deducted from refunds for returns, and prepaid return option is not available.
rules.quote: The prepaid return option is not available. For returns made in accordance with this policy, a $20 restocking fee will be deducted from the refund, subject to applicable law.

rules.text: Returns without proof of purchase may be credited as merchandise credit at current selling price.
rules.quote: Returns made without proof of purchase may be credited at the item’s current selling price on the date of return, in the form of a merchandise credit
